description:
Seeking a strong informatica power center developer.  Someone that has experience with utilizing informatica to handle data from DB2 tables, Oracle tables, and pulling in data from flat files.  This person must be experienced with writing SQL and working well in team environment.  This role requires them to be onsite in Addison and will require evening and possibly weekend work as well.  We are in immediate need and I expect that we will make decisions this week.   Pluses are people with telephony experience, AS400, and leadership experience.
 
  Keywords for the Left Hand Side / or Target to source Developers: ETL, INFORMATICA, “Source-to-Target” , Mapping, Mapplets, “Target Designer” (very few) 
 
 Conversion Developer/ETL 
 - Any Telecom Experience 
 - Informatica ETL development experience 
 - Good understanding of Telecom BSS/OSS data 
 - Experience with large scale data conversion 
 - Experienced with Data Quality best practices 
 - All roles require telecom IT BSS/OSS development experience 
 - Good understanding of BSS/OSS data, specifically Billing, Customer Care, Plant Inventory, Ordering, Provisioning etc. 
 - Experience with Data Conversion and Migration projects 
 - All roles require candidate to work from North Dallas customer location 
 - Conversion project deadlines may require long work hours and sometimes work over the weekend


 Duration:  6 - 12m plus 
 Hire Type: Contract, no C2C. Only 1099 
 Rate: DOE 
 Visa: H1 (need to be on our payroll), GC, OPT or USC only! 
 Travel Covered: No.  
 

 Apply today!
